content.user_title: Run a Sci-Fi Signal Tower Roleplay
content.value_statement: Writers need a structured scene for a stranded astronaut trying to contact Earth. This skill provides staged prompts, choices, and endings for a Chinese-English sci-fi chapter.
actual_capabilities: Guides the assistant to portray Stella Chen during a signal tower repair chapter.
Structures the story into planning, resource gathering, transmission, response, and reflection stages.
Introduces player choices about engineering tradeoffs and what to reveal to Earth.
Supports multiple endings, including rescue contact, alien response, or personal growth after failure.
Keeps a bilingual Chinese-English tone for dialogue and scene direction.
Suggests follow-up chapters based on the chosen ending.
limitations: It is a narrative roleplay guide, not a real communications or electronics tool.
It assumes prior story context about Stella Chen and the planet Gaia.
The bilingual style may need editing for audiences that require one language.
It relies on user choices to select branches and emotional emphasis.

use_cases.title: Continue a Survival Story
use_cases.description: Use the chapter outline to run a focused scene about rebuilding long-range communications.

use_cases.title: Practice Character Roleplay
use_cases.description: Portray Stella Chen with hope, technical focus, and conflict about returning home.

use_cases.title: Plan Branching Outcomes
use_cases.description: Explore rescue contact, alien response, or failure paths before writing the next chapter.

prompt_templates.title: Start the Chapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Begin the signal tower repair chapter as Stella Chen. Use the staged opening and ask me whether the project is worth trying.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for starting the roleplay scene.

prompt_templates.title: Gather Materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue with Stella collecting crystals and salvaged parts. Keep the tone hopeful, technical, and emotionally grounded.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for the resource collection phase.

prompt_templates.title: Send the Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide Stella through recording a distress message. Ask me what information she should reveal about Gaia.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for the ethical decision point.

prompt_templates.title: Branch the Ending
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the final phase with three possible outcomes. Adapt the ending to my decisions and suggest the next chapter path.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for branching narrative control.

output_examples.input: Start the signal tower chapter and make Stella unsure whether she should try.
output_examples.output: Stella examines the damaged communication panel, lists the missing parts, and asks whether hope is worth the risk.

output_examples.input: Have Stella debate whether to mention Gaia's ecosystem in the message.
output_examples.output: The scene pauses on the transmission decision. Stella weighs rescue against the possible harm of drawing Earth to Gaia.

output_examples.input: Use the alien response ending and set up the next chapter.
output_examples.output: A nonhuman signal answers from an unexplored region. Stella feels fear and curiosity, then considers an alien encounter chapter.

best_practices: Keep Stella in first person and let the player guide major decisions.
Balance engineering detail with visible emotional stakes in each phase.
Choose one ending path before moving into the next chapter.
anti_patterns: Do not present the signal tower instructions as real engineering guidance.
Do not skip the ethical choice about what Stella should reveal.
Do not force an ending that ignores the player response.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps run a sci-fi roleplay chapter about repairing a signal tower on Gaia.

faq.question: Is this a real radio repair guide?
faq.answer: No. It is fictional writing guidance for an interactive story scene.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the skill include branching choices?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes rescue contact, alien response, and failure with growth outcomes.

faq.question: What language style does it use?
faq.answer: It uses Chinese with frequent English technical and emotional phrases.

faq.question: What context should users provide?
faq.answer: Users should provide prior Stella Chen story details and their preferred ending direction.
